panels.description: Late afternoon on Keel’s pit rim. Keel lies in shadow, Halyard catches gold and Oasis remains in sunlight. A dry fountain stands nearby as Ada approaches with two battered mugs. Leave upper-left clear.
Ada offers Alex a mug, her ration card visible at her hip. Leave upper-left and upper-right clear.
Close on the ration card, Ada’s hand and Alex’s hands around the mugs. Keep four lettering zones separate.
Alex and Ada sit side by side on the railing, laughing briefly. Reserve upper-left for Ada and upper-right for Alex, with no overlap.
Ada watches Alex while he looks away, his frustration over Site 6’s credit visible in his clenched posture. Reserve separate upper-left and lower-left balloon zones.
Alex looks upward toward Oasis while Ada looks down toward Keel, wind lifting her red hair. Reserve a clean upper-left zone for Alex’s short balloon and lower-right for Ada’s short balloon.

items.speaker: ALEX
items.text: The birthday special? Not sure I can afford it.

items.speaker: ALEX
items.text: Where'd you get enough water for two?

items.speaker: ADA
items.text: Not everything has a price, Alex.

items.speaker: ALEX
items.text: And my bracket's in the Site 6 catalog now. Their name on it. Not mine.

items.speaker: ALEX
items.text: Every birthday... I look up there... and wonder what it feels like to wake up somewhere you get to choose your own future.

items.speaker: ADA
items.text: I look down here... and wonder why everyone gave up trying to change it.

items.speaker: ADA
items.text: That's the problem. People stopped trying to make it worth staying.
